flows.narrative: The freshest weekly read flipped to risk-on-and-stretched: BofA's Flow Show showed a historic drain of cash into risk (a ~$119.6bn money-market outflow, largest since Apr 2026 per the source) with global equities +$55.8bn, EM equities +$25bn (strongest weekly since Apr 2025), tech funds +$15.6bn (a record ~$48.8bn over three weeks) and financials +$2.7bn (largest since Jan). IG credit extended a 15-week inflow streak (+$9.5bn) while gold saw only a token +$0.5bn and crypto -$0.1bn. Crucially, BofA's Bull & Bear Indicator hit an extreme 9.6 — a contrarian 'reduce risk' signal — and Hartnett flags Mag7 capex as the market's fragile last line of defense. The tension worth noting: these flows show aggressive greed even as sentiment gauges (CNN 38 Fear) and daily breadth deteriorated into the 20 July close — flows lag price.
